Back the Steel

The Reavers are a volunteer-run nonprofit. Sponsors put loaner armour on new fighters, get the team to tournaments, and bring live armoured combat to schools and festivals across Central Alberta.

Why the Reavers

Hard to miss

Full-contact fighting in steel draws a crowd. Your name goes where the team goes: on the list at tournaments, at community demos, and in the photos and videos people share afterwards.

I

Events

On the field

Banners and tabards at the tournaments we enter and host, and at demos in schools, markets and festivals.

II

Online

On our channels

Sponsor posts on Instagram and Facebook, and your logo and link on this page all season.

III

Local

In the community

A registered nonprofit in Red Deer. Your support goes straight to gear, travel, venue time and outreach.
